newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France sees Asian alliance in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Air France sees Asian alliance in 1997.

text.p: French state-owned airline Air France expects to conclude an alliance deal with an Asian carrier in 1997 after its recent pacts with Delta Air Lines and Continental Airlines.
"Our next aim is to conclude an Asian partnership. I expect we will have such a deal in 1997," Air France chairman Christian Blanc told a seminar at the Sorbonne university.
Blanc said that airlines no longer could suffice with transporting people from one point to another but were turning into "network companies".

"The big art is how the manage a network of hubs. How to let those hubs grow," Blanc said. A hub is airline industry jargon for a central airport with intercontinenal connerction to which regional feeder lines converge.
"The airline company of the future is a network of seven, eight, maybe ten hubs," Blanc said.
